start: Profile tab, Settings, 'Your profile' (page title 'Your profile')

steps.action: Tap Goal chip 'Lose fat'
user_sees: 'Changes save as you go.' with 'Saved' beside it for a moment
must_not: A 'Save profile' button needed
A pop-up to confirm

steps.action: Type 28 in 'Age · optional' and stop typing
must_not: Saved while still half-typed with an error
The age box cleared

steps.action: Type a height in 'Height' (cm, or inches in imperial) and tap Experience 'Intermediate'
must_not: Height stored in the wrong unit
Typing in Age delays the save of Height

steps.action: Leave the page and open it again
user_sees: Goal 'Lose fat', age 28, the height and 'Intermediate' as set
must_not: Any value back to the old one

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

steps.action: Tap 'Remove' beside the number
must_not: An 'Are you sure?' question
The bar shown when the remove did not save

steps.action: Tap 'Undo' within 6 seconds
user_sees: The old number back in the box
must_not: The number stays removed
The bar goes before 6 seconds

start: Your profile, 'Body figure' chips 'Male' and 'Female'

steps.action: Tap 'Female'
user_sees: 'The body drawn on Charts and on share pictures.'
must_not: The other chips change

steps.action: Open Progress, Charts
must_not: The male body still drawn

start: Your profile

steps.action: Type 150 in Age and leave the box
user_sees: Under the box: 'Enter an age between {min} and {max}, or leave it blank.'
must_not: 150 saved
A pop-up
'Saved' shown

steps.action: Type 5 digits that are not a mobile number and leave the box
user_sees: A line under the mobile number box saying what is wrong
must_not: The bad number saved
The old number lost

steps.action: Type a height outside the allowed range and leave the box
user_sees: 'Enter a height between {min} and {max} cm, or leave it blank.' (inches in imperial)
must_not: The height saved
The error spoken twice

start: Your profile; the phone's storage refuses the save once

steps.action: Tap Goal 'Get stronger'
user_sees: The chip moves, then moves back
must_not: 'Saved' shown
The new goal kept on screen while not stored

steps.action: Tap 'Try again'
must_not: The tap made twice
A box the member never touched saved again

steps.action: After 'Erase or start over', open Your profile
user_sees: An empty profile, no values from before
must_not: The card writes old values back after the erase

start: Your profile, typing a mobile number

steps.action: Type a number in 'Mobile number · optional' and look under it
user_sees: 'Any country. Stays on this phone; only your gym will use it, once you link one.'
must_not: The number sent anywhere before a gym is linked
The number shown to gym mates

steps.action: Remove the number
must_not: The number kept in the phone after the bar goes
